show_resolved.description: e.g. 'Last run of AF 2 h 14 min ago'.
show_resolved.title: Show Resolved

AlarmDefault.description: Design-level default limits. Per-patient overrides are patient data.
AlarmDefault.title: AlarmDefault

Button.description: A button in the tab bar or the top bar. Where it sits is the designer's choice.
Button.title: Button

CertaintyDisplay.description: Which certainty metric drives the display, and how it is shown.
CertaintyDisplay.title: CertaintyDisplay

LabelDisplay.description: How names are written on screen.
LabelDisplay.title: LabelDisplay

row_ids.description: Rows to show, top to bottom.
row_ids.title: Row Ids

column_source.description: 'charted' = recorded observation sets; 'continuous' = derived from the wearable every interval.
column_source.title: Column Source

NotificationsDisplay.description:
The notification box: the one place alarms and monitoring problems are listed.

It is always on screen and always the same size. It says 'No Notifications' or
shows the most important item with a count; touching it opens the full list
over the screen. Nothing that arrives may move or resize the rest of the monitor.

flash.description: Flash at the item's priority rate.
flash.title: Flash

NotificationsDisplay.title: NotificationsDisplay

Row.description: One monitoring item with its trace and numbers.

method.description: How it is measured, shown after the label as 'Heart Rate - ECG'. Overrides the default (the row's waveform, else the registry method).
method.title: Method

numerics.description: Numbers shown at the right of the row, largest first.
numerics.title: Numerics

show_ai.description: Show AI interpretation text on this row.
show_ai.title: Show Ai

Row.title: Row

SafetyDisplay.description:
How monitoring problems are shown. See docs/human-factors.md.

Only presentation is adjustable here. That each state is shown, and shown
differently from every other state, is fixed: there is no option to hide the
alarm-paused state, a technical alarm, a battery warning or a lost signal.
SafetyDisplay.title: SafetyDisplay

SettingsAction.description: Opens the menu whose id is 'settings' (which must exist).
SettingsAction.title: SettingsAction

SheetAction.description: Opens a built-in panel over the current screen.
SheetAction.title: SheetAction

SilenceAction.description: Silences alarm audio for registry.ALARM_SILENCE_SECONDS (2 minutes).
SilenceAction.title: SilenceAction

SplitNode.description: Two panes side by side ('horizontal') or stacked ('vertical').

ratio.description: Share taken by the first pane.
ratio.title: Ratio

SplitNode.title: SplitNode

Sweep.description: How waveforms are drawn. The 'sweep break' is the moving erase gap.
Sweep.title: Sweep

mode.description: Which side of the dark / light switch this theme is.
mode.title: Mode

parameter_colours.description: Trace and numeric colour per parameter.
parameter_colours.title: Parameter Colours

forecast.description: Dashed forecast lines and bands. Keep distinct from the NEWS score colours.
forecast.title: Forecast

inactive.description: STANDBY and SEARCHING text: nothing is being measured.
inactive.title: Inactive

silenced.description: The alarm-sound-paused state: the silence button and its banner. Conventionally yellow.
silenced.title: Silenced

technical.description: Technical alarms and signal problems (connection, battery, sensor, poor trace). Must differ from the patient alarm colours.
technical.title: Technical

ThemeToggleAction.description:
Switches this screen between the design's dark and light themes. A local
preference of the screen (day / night); it does not create a design version.
ThemeToggleAction.title: ThemeToggleAction

TileDisplay.description:
The square holding one number. Every tile on the monitor is the same width,
and a tile never changes size whatever it shows: a number, STANDBY, CONNECTION
LOST and a low-battery warning all fit the same box.
TileDisplay.title: TileDisplay

buttons.description: Buttons at the right of the top bar, left to right (for example new patient, discharge, dark / light, settings).
buttons.title: Buttons

fields.description: Left to right. Must include 'name' and 'clock'.
fields.title: Fields

alt_theme.description: The other side of the dark / light switch.
